mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing chlorpromazine plasma concentrations and efficacy; additive CNS depression and potential for reduced seizure control if chlorpromazine lowers seizure threshold.
action: Monitor chlorpromazine efficacy closely and consider dose adjustment; assess seizure frequency regularly as chlorpromazine may lower seizure threshold despite enzyme induction effects.
